supported_passages: The clubs first met on 13 May 1902 in the Copa de la Coronación, with Barcelona winning 3–1. La Liga explicitly notes that this tournament is not recognised by the RFEF, even though its historical comparison includes the game. The first league Clásico was on 17 February 1929 at Les Corts: Madrid won 2–1. Those are different questions with different answers. [2]

The 1916 cup tie: after one win each, a 6–6 extra-time playoff still failed to settle the contest. Madrid won a fourth match 4–2 after extra time. It is a reminder that the rivalry’s high drama long predates television. [2]

La Liga’s published historical total is level: 106 wins each and 52 draws across 264 meetings , including the 1902 Coronation Cup and excluding friendlies. The page is dated 10 May 2026 and was checked for this guide on 9 October. Sporting News independently reports the same headline total. [2] [5]

Madrid’s 11–1 cup victory in 1943 is the rivalry’s largest competitive winning margin.
